name: Nectar
oneLiner: NECT is Beraborrow's Liquity v2-style overcollateralized stablecoin on Berachain, minted against iBGT, WBERA, BTC/ETH variants, and Kodiak Island LPs.
collateral: Berachain-native Collateral Vault branches: iBGT (Infrared liquid staked BGT), iBERA, WBERA, pumpBTC, solvBTC, solvBTC.bbn, uniBTC, beraETH, Stakestone ETH, WETH, ylstETH, rsETH, and Kodiak Island LP pairs (WBTC-HONEY, WETH-HONEY, WETH-WBTC)
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with redemption for collateral at $1 face value (Liquity-style); operates on Berachain (not Ethereum or a Stage 1 L2)

oracleRisk.summary: Beraborrow publishes collateral oracle provider mappings such as RedStone, Chronicle, and eOracle, but reviewed docs do not show stronger failover handling.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified NECT debt-token contract leaves ordinary transfer and transferFrom unguarded by a blacklist or pause check. However, its MetaBeraborrowCore owner can whitelist DenManager, borrower-operations, and PSM contracts; those whitelisted modules can call burn(account, amount) against an arbitrary account. This is a material owner-mediated holder intervention surface, so Possible is retained rather than asserting no freeze exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

reserveReview.rationale: The independent Liquity-v2 branch producer read all configured positive Beraborrow collateral branches in one current Berachain capture and normalized thirteen exact positions. Direct wrapped assets and liquid-staking tokens retain their market, custody, counterparty, liquidity, and smart-contract risks; Kodiak Islands remain protocol positions with LP basis and concentration risks.

mintAuthority.summary: NECT is a Liquity v2-style overcollateralized stablecoin on Berachain, minted from collateral-vault (Den) branches such as iBGT, WBERA, BTC/ETH variants, and Kodiak Island LPs. Beraborrow retains admin/governance control over collateral branch onboarding (some collateral is permissioned); renouncement is not confirmed.

controls.label: NECT token / registered Beraborrow branch minters
controls.capDescription: NECT mints only via registered Beraborrow collateral-vault (Den) branches against overcollateralized positions, with Liquity-style $1-face-value redemptions; supply is bounded by collateralized borrowing. Branch registration and debt ceilings are controlled by the Registry owner (4-of-7 Beraborrow Safe behind a 3-day timelock), which can raise mint capacity by registering new branches or adjusting parameters.
controls.evidence: Beraborrow docs describe Dens depositing collateral to mint the overcollateralized stablecoin NECT (Liquity v2-style), with NECT token at 0x1cE0a25D13CE4d52071aE7e02Cf1F6606F4C79d3.

controls.label: Beraborrow Registry owner Safe (4/7) with 3-day timelock
controls.capDescription: 4-of-7 Beraborrow Safe owns the Registry contract (which controls branch/minter registration for NECT), subject to a 3-day timelock (259,200 seconds). NECT token has no owner() function and no OpenZeppelin Ownable/AccessControl — minting is whitelisted via TroveManagers/BorrowerOperations/DebtManager mappings controlled by the Registry.
controls.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792, NECT token (0x1ce0a25d) has no owner() (reverts), no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode. Mint requires caller in TroveManagers (slot 8), BorrowerOperations (slot 11), or DebtManager (slot 12) mappings. Registry at 0x27393e8a owner() returned 0xce7d3fd53c0510325b3cebb96298522e6c538753 (Gnosis Safe L2, masterCopy 0x3e5c6364). RPC getOwners() returned 7 signers, getThreshold() returned 4. Registry timelock delay = 0x3f480 = 259200s (3 days). Safe modules/guard not confirmed via Safe API (Berachain Safe API endpoint unclear). Direct Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745: getOwners() returned 7 owners, getThreshold()=4, no modules, no guard, masterCopy GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0.

review.evidence: At Berachain block 22088792: NECT token has no Ownable/AccessControl in bytecode; owner() reverts; mint() reverts with 'Debt: Caller not BO/DM' (whitelisted contract minting). Registry at 0x27393e8a6f8f2e32b870903279999c820e984dc7 owned by 0xce7d3fd5 (4/7 Gnosis Safe L2, confirmed via RPC getOwners/getThreshold), timelock delay 3 days. Control is NOT renounced — Safe retains authority to add branch minters via Registry. Reclassification to immutable-user-collateralized is NOT appropriate. Berachain RPC reads at block 22089745 resolved the Registry owner Safe: getModulesPaginated returned no modules and the guard slot is zero, clearing the final modules/guards blocker.
